overall_verdict: A. Ready for continued paper evidence accumulation

findings.title: No real order/fill/cancel sample yet
findings.evidence: trading.db read-only counts: orders=0, fills=0, position_events=0; docs/reports/task_088/task_088_evidence_summary.json has order_attempts=0, filled_orders=0, cancelled_orders=0
findings.recommended_action: Continue paper only until at least one real submitted, filled/partial, cancelled, and reconciled sample is captured.

findings.title: Runtime signals are not proven equivalent to backtest signals
findings.recommended_action: Add a backtest/live signal alignment replay test over the same bars and selected symbols.

findings.title: Backtest PnL is not capital-return evidence
findings.evidence: src/backtest/engine_full.py uses initial_equity, MAX_POSITION_WEIGHT, and quantity sizing; docs/reports/task_083/task_083_portfolio_validation.md shows low CapUtil; docs/reports/task_084/task_084_strategy_lock.md reports NetPnL/PF
findings.recommended_action: Build capital-based portfolio backtest reporting CAGR, exposure, cash, position sizing, and return on capital.

findings.title: KIS quote throttling causes partial symbol evaluation
findings.evidence: docs/reports/task_089/task_089_market_signal_refresh.json evaluated 4/12 symbols and records eight EGW00201 throttle failures
findings.recommended_action: Add quote throttling/backoff, per-symbol retry budget, and explicit degraded-universe status.

findings.title: Production scheduler and alerting are not sufficient
findings.recommended_action: Add a supervised scheduler, heartbeat, structured logs, and alerts for stale data, no-order streaks, throttle failures, and evidence FAIL.

findings.title: Task 087/088/089 responsibilities overlap and can obscure root cause
findings.evidence: scripts/run_phase5_paper_loop.ps1 runs 089 -> 087 -> 088; src/app/task_087_pilot_evidence.py invokes task 085 and records external failures
findings.recommended_action: Define a single run envelope schema with component status, broker status, signal status, and evidence status.

findings.title: Live environment is blocked in Task 087 but run_trade_once has separate live gating semantics
findings.recommended_action: Document and test the exact paper/live state machine and required env/control_state transitions.

findings.title: Fixed 12-symbol universe and survivorship risk remain
findings.recommended_action: Add dated universe snapshots or clearly label results as fixed-universe candidate research.

findings.title: KIS fixtures are synthetic contract samples, not broker proof
findings.evidence: tests/fixtures/kis/*.json; tests/test_kis_cancel_contract.py; no non-empty tests/replay broker sample
findings.recommended_action: Capture sanitized real KIS order/fill/cancel/reconcile fixtures and replay them in tests.

findings.title: UI does not yet make no-order/no-signal/root-cause decisions obvious enough
findings.recommended_action: Add a Paper Ops decision panel with root-cause hierarchy and red/yellow risk states.

findings.title: Artifacts and runtime DB are spread across task folders and project root
findings.evidence: docs/reports/task_066b through task_089; docs/audits; root trading.db; docs/tmp
findings.recommended_action: Adopt data/runtime, docs/reports/tasks/task_xxx, and retention/archive conventions.

findings.title: Evidence and report accumulation can become slower over time
findings.evidence: src/app/task_088_evidence_decision.py scans all docs/reports/task_087/runs/*.json; docs/reports/task_087/runs currently has 9 JSON runs
findings.recommended_action: Add rolling indexes, date partitions, and archive policy for evidence and logs.

findings.title: Strategy reports use confident labels that can create false confidence
findings.recommended_action: Rewrite strategy-lock language to distinguish candidate strategy, paper readiness, and live readiness.

findings.title: Task granularity is useful but needs checkpoint discipline
findings.recommended_action: Use planner/executor/reviewer/tester roles for large tasks and require checkpoint summaries.

recommended_next_tasks.title: Paper Broker Lifecycle Evidence Gate
acceptance_criteria: At least one real paper submitted order is captured and sanitized.
At least one fill or partial fill sample is captured and reconciled.
At least one cancel path sample is captured or explicitly marked unavailable with broker evidence.
Task 088 aggregate distinguishes no-signal/no-order from lifecycle evidence completion.

recommended_next_tasks.title: Backtest/Runtime Signal Alignment
acceptance_criteria: Replay uses the same symbols and bars for locked backtest logic and Task 089/runtime logic.
All mismatches are reported with symbol, timestamp, input values, and reason.
Locked strategy sample has zero unexplained alignment mismatches.

recommended_next_tasks.title: KIS Quote Throttle Hardening
acceptance_criteria: Task 089 either evaluates all configured symbols or marks the run as degraded.
Throttle failures include skipped symbols and retry counts.
Candidate selection cannot silently rank only the first successfully queried subset.

recommended_next_tasks.title: Capital-Based Portfolio Backtest
acceptance_criteria: Report includes cash, exposure, position sizing, CAGR or return on capital, MDD on equity, and capital utilization.
NetPnL is no longer presented as investable return without capital context.
D_PORTFOLIO_SECTOR_FILTER is reclassified as candidate, paper-ready, or rejected under capital metrics.

recommended_next_tasks.title: Paper Ops Decision UI
acceptance_criteria: Latest run UI explains no order using a clear root-cause hierarchy.
Risk states such as UNKNOWN, reconciliation critical, stale data, throttle, and missing credentials are visually prominent.
Operator can see order/fill/cancel/reconcile status without reading JSON files.
